title: Speaking — Learning outdoors
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on learning outdoors.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
What have you learned from spending time outdoors?
Would you rather learn about nature through a visit or a book?

part2.topic: Describe something you discovered on a walk or another outdoor visit.
part2.closing: and explain why the discovery made you more curious.

questions: How can outdoor lessons complement classroom teaching?
What makes natural areas accessible for people with limited mobility?
How has everyday life connected with learning outdoors changed for people of different ages?
